interface.signature: def scramble(s: str, indices: list[int]) -> str:

preconditions.description: The input string `s` and the index array `indices` must have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(s) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: Every element in `indices` must be a valid index for the string `s` (i.e., between 0 and len(s)-1, inclusive).

postconditions.description: The returned string has the same length as the input string `s`.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == s[indices[i]] for i in range(len(indices)))
postconditions.description: For each index `i` in `indices`, the character at position `i` in the returned string is the character from `s` at position `indices[i]`.
